column1: # ABOUTME: Measured wall-clock seconds per pierre-server integration test file.
# ABOUTME: Weights for the longest-processing-time shard packing in ci-postgres.yml.
# Source: run 33935335499 (main, c44a8d9a7, green, full suite).
# WEIGHTS ONLY. The set of files that runs always comes from
# `find crates/pierre-server/tests`, so a file absent here still runs — it is
# weighted at the p90 of this table so a new test is never assumed to be free.
# A stale entry costs balance, never coverage.
# The packer adds a per-file BUILD cost to every weight, including the ones here:
# a file that runs in 0.0s still has to be compiled and linked. That constant stays
# at the 0.61s fitted from run 33917276134, whose shards spanned 97 to 259 files.
# This run's shards all hold 137-141, so refitting the slope on it would be fitting
# noise across a four-file range — its own residuals disagree about the sign.
# Refreshed after the sleep and crypto work (c44a8d9a7): 122 entries had moved by
# more than 5s, the largest being oauth2_rate_limiting_e2e_test at 121.0s -> 3.0s.
